segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making the time. I had us down for 30 minutes to walk through the 18 additional seats for the operations team and the March 4 go-live. Is that still the right agenda?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that's right. We have 42 seats today, and the request is to move to 60 total. The main thing is confirming the price and making sure the invoice can hit our April budget.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep. Based on the pricing sheet, 60 seats on your current annual plan comes to $48,600 for the new term, before tax. Since your renewal starts April 1, the invoice would be dated April 1 with net 30 terms, same as today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the onboarding session for the new supervisors? We have 12 of them who need the admin view, not just basic access.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. I included two live training sessions, 60 minutes each, and admin permissions for those 12 supervisors. The rest would stay as standard users unless you tell us otherwise.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One thing, procurement asked whether the term can be 12 months exactly, April 1, 2026 through March 31, 2027. They don't want an odd end date.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, totally fine. The order form will show April 1 through March 31, and the seat count will be 60 from day one. No mid-term prorate since we're aligning it to renewal.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. On payment, can you keep the PO number field blank for now? We'll issue the PO after legal signs the order form, probably by next Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can leave PO pending and reference it on the invoice once you send it over. I'll send the order form today with the 60 seats, $48,600 annual subscription, net 30, and the training detail in the notes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. If you send it to me and copy Marcus in procurement, I'll route it internally. Assuming no surprises, we can sign by February 14.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I'll have it in your inbox this afternoon, and I'll also send a short implementation timeline so your team can plan the March 4 kickoff.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thanks. This is straightforward. Talk soon.
